title: Zabt
overview: Uday, a builder, is about to close an important deal but needs a large amount of money to buy the land. He borrows it from an underworld loan shark, but the money is stolen, which puts him in a serious trouble. At the same time, people seeking revenge on Chandra, a criminal who is now dead, turn their focus toward Uday. Trapped in danger, Uday must recover his stolen money, protect himself, and clear his name—unaware that an unexpected twist is yet to come.

songs.title: Zindagi Me Nazm O Zabt Ki Zarurat
